failures.claim: The DMN checksum algorithm can be set to MD5 via the NUVEI_DMN_CHECKSUM_ALGORITHM environment variable.
failures.expected: NUVEI_DMN_CHECKSUM_ALGORITHM supports md5 as well as sha256
failures.actual: processor/src/config/config.ts hard-codes nuveiDmnChecksumAlgorithm to sha256 and validateConfig rejects any NUVEI_DMN_CHECKSUM_ALGORITHM value other than sha256

failures.claim: merchant_unique_id is the commercetools Payment ID set during openOrder.
failures.expected: openOrder request sets merchant_unique_id to the commercetools Payment ID
failures.actual: processor/src/clients/nuvei.client.ts openOrder signs only merchantId, merchantSiteId, clientRequestId, amount, currency, timeStamp, and secretKey; enabler/src/components/card.ts and enabler/src/dropin/dropin-embedded.ts set merchant_unique_id later in SafeCharge createPayment options

failures.claim: advanceResponseChecksum is an HMAC checksum for validation.
failures.actual: processor/src/clients/nuvei.client.ts validates advanceResponseChecksum with crypto.createHash(algorithm) over secretKey + totalAmount + currency + responseTimeStamp + PPP_TransactionID + Status + productId, not with crypto.createHmac

failures.claim: The connector processor exposes a /health endpoint.
failures.actual: no /health route exists under processor/src; processor/src/routes/operation.route.ts exposes GET /status for status checks

failures.claim: NUVEI_DMN_CHECKSUM_ALGORITHM may match sha256 or md5.
failures.actual: processor/src/config/config.ts throws when NUVEI_DMN_CHECKSUM_ALGORITHM is set to any value other than sha256; connect.yaml describes the setting as 'sha256 only'
